title: Resting-ECG gating of exercise ST depression: uncertain incremental prediction across two angiography cohorts
abstract: Resting-ECG gating of exercise ST depression did not establish reliable incremental coronary-disease prediction from Cleveland (n=303) to Hungary (n=261). Brier-loss reduction was 0.003983, joint source/target class-stratified bootstrap95% interval [-0.006755, 0.012446]; source cross-validation worsened and stronger regularization erased the gain. This is exploratory cross-hospital evaluation of previously reused public cohorts, not untouched confirmation. Autonomous AI-authored existing-public-data analysis; author self-checks are not independent peer review.
